description: Na₇UH₄S₄O₂₀Cl crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are eight inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O and two equivalent Cl atoms to form distorted NaCl₂O₄ octahedra that share corners with four NaClO₅ octahedra, corners with four equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaCl₂O₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 80-99°. There are two shorter (2.35 Å) and two longer (2.37 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Both Na-Cl bond lengths are 3.05 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.52-2.86 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.53 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one UO₇ pentagonal bipyramid, corners with four SO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one SO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 73°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.82 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to four O and two equivalent Cl atoms to form distorted NaCl₂O₄ octahedra that share corners with four NaCl₂O₄ octahedra, corners with three SO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaCl₂O₄ octahedra, and  a faceface with one NaClO₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 20-99°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.55 Å. There is one shorter (2.74 Å) and one longer (2.79 Å) Na-Cl bond length. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded to five O and one Cl atom to form distorted NaClO₅ octahedra that share corners with two NaCl₂O₄ octahedra, corners with three SO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid, and  a faceface with one NaCl₂O₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 57-80°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.57 Å. The Na-Cl bond length is 2.94 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six O and one Cl atom. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.81 Å. The Na-Cl bond length is 2.97 Å. In the eighth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one UO₇ pentagonal bipyramid, corners with four SO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one SO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.74 Å. U is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid, and corners with five SO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 54°. There are a spread of U-O bond distances ranging from 1.81-2.54 Å. There are four inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. There are four inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 52°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.48-1.51 Å. In the second S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one UO₇ pentagonal bipyramid, and  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 18-74°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.47-1.51 Å. In the third S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two NaCl₂O₄ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one UO₇ pentagonal bipyramid,  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 27-43°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.47-1.54 Å. In the fourth S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with five NaCl₂O₄ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one UO₇ pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-66°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.47-1.53 Å. There are twenty inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Na and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one U, and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to three Na and one S atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₃S trigonal pyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to three Na and one S atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₃S tetrahedra. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one U and one S atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one S atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one U, and one S atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one S atom. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the sixteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one U, and one S atom. In the seventeenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one U atom. In the eighteenth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and one U atom. In the nineteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two Na and two H atoms. In the twentieth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two Na and two H atoms. Cl is bonded in a distorted pentagonal planar geometry to five Na atoms.
